notable.note: The most commercially revealing call in the batch. Under direct questioning the rep disclosed a three-tier ladder that appears nowhere in the documented offer: 'Kettlebell Buddy' at $6,000/6mo (one-to-one with Trevor), 'Kettlebell Buddy Light' at $3,000/6mo (Trevor programmes, Caden delivers check-ins and form feedback), and 'University' at $1,000/6mo (self-serve). The rep confirmed none of it is published — 'does this website list all the programs? No... we don't just offer it to everyone.' He also stated the upgrade-credit policy three incompatible ways in four minutes. Separately, the prospect said his doctors have pressed statins on him for years and that it is 'just an industry over here', and the rep agreed with him: 'you're in charge of your health... You can make the decisions yourself.' Useful corpus intelligence: the rep named the only two closers as himself and Andrew in Poland.

quality.notes: Severe swapping throughout — the opening line is attributed to the rep but is the prospect's, and the entire pricing sequence from 00:46 to 00:59 has questions and answers repeatedly inverted, including the tier prices appearing under the prospect's label. Roles resolved from content. A Wi-Fi dropout of roughly two minutes at 00:55:20-00:57:19 falls in the middle of the upgrade-credit discussion, so part of that exchange is not captured. A long unpunctuated ASR run at 00:42:41-00:44:14 and again at 00:59:58-01:01:01 merges many turns.
